description:
Convert an IPv4 address between dotted-decimal, integer, binary, and hex forms. Accepts any of those as input.

Returns: JSON { decimal, integer, hex, binary } representations of the IPv4 address.
Example input: {"value":"192.168.1.1"}
On error, includes hint: `value` accepts dotted (192.168.0.1), integer (3232235521), 32-bit binary, or 0x-prefixed hex.

value.description: IPv4 in dotted (192.168.0.1), integer (3232235521), binary (32 bits), or hex (0xC0A80001) form.

name: ip_convert
title: IPv4 converter
